
------------------------------------------------------------
Tasks runnable from root project 'gradle-multi'
------------------------------------------------------------

Application tasks
-----------------
app:run - Runs this project as a JVM application

Build tasks
-----------
app:assemble - Assembles the outputs of this project.
core:assemble - Assembles the outputs of this project.
app:build - Assembles and tests this project.
core:build - Assembles and tests this project.
app:buildDependents - Assembles and tests this project and all projects that depend on it.
core:buildDependents - Assembles and tests this project and all projects that depend on it.
app:buildNeeded - Assembles and tests this project and all projects it depends on.
core:buildNeeded - Assembles and tests this project and all projects it depends on.
app:classes - Assembles main classes.
core:classes - Assembles main classes.
app:clean - Deletes the build directory.
core:clean - Deletes the build directory.
app:jar - Assembles a jar archive containing the classes of the 'main' feature.
core:jar - Assembles a jar archive containing the classes of the 'main' feature.
app:testClasses - Assembles test classes.
core:testClasses - Assembles test classes.

Build Setup tasks
-----------------
init - Initializes a new Gradle build.
updateDaemonJvm - Generates or updates the Gradle Daemon JVM criteria.
wrapper - Generates Gradle wrapper files.

Distribution tasks
------------------
app:assembleDist - Assembles the main distributions
app:distTar - Bundles the project as a distribution.
app:distZip - Bundles the project as a distribution.
app:installDist - Installs the project as a distribution as-is.

Documentation tasks
-------------------
app:javadoc - Generates Javadoc API documentation for the 'main' feature.
core:javadoc - Generates Javadoc API documentation for the 'main' feature.

Help tasks
----------
artifactTransforms - Displays the Artifact Transforms that can be executed in root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:artifactTransforms - Displays the Artifact Transforms that can be executed in project ':app'.
core:artifactTransforms - Displays the Artifact Transforms that can be executed in project ':core'.
buildEnvironment - Displays all buildscript dependencies declared in root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:buildEnvironment - Displays all buildscript dependencies declared in project ':app'.
core:buildEnvironment - Displays all buildscript dependencies declared in project ':core'.
dependencies - Displays all dependencies declared in root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:dependencies - Displays all dependencies declared in project ':app'.
core:dependencies - Displays all dependencies declared in project ':core'.
dependencyInsight - Displays the insight into a specific dependency in root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:dependencyInsight - Displays the insight into a specific dependency in project ':app'.
core:dependencyInsight - Displays the insight into a specific dependency in project ':core'.
help - Displays a help message.
app:help - Displays a help message.
core:help - Displays a help message.
javaToolchains - Displays the detected java toolchains.
app:javaToolchains - Displays the detected java toolchains.
core:javaToolchains - Displays the detected java toolchains.
outgoingVariants - Displays the outgoing variants of root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:outgoingVariants - Displays the outgoing variants of project ':app'.
core:outgoingVariants - Displays the outgoing variants of project ':core'.
projects - Displays the sub-projects of root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:projects - Displays the sub-projects of project ':app'.
core:projects - Displays the sub-projects of project ':core'.
properties - Displays the properties of root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:properties - Displays the properties of project ':app'.
core:properties - Displays the properties of project ':core'.
resolvableConfigurations - Displays the configurations that can be resolved in root project 'gradle-multi'.
app:resolvableConfigurations - Displays the configurations that can be resolved in project ':app'.
core:resolvableConfigurations - Displays the configurations that can be resolved in project ':core'.
tasks - Displays the tasks runnable from root project 'gradle-multi' (some of the displayed tasks may belong to subprojects).
app:tasks - Displays the tasks runnable from project ':app'.
core:tasks - Displays the tasks runnable from project ':core'.

Verification tasks
------------------
app:check - Runs all checks.
core:check - Runs all checks.
app:test - Runs the test suite.
core:test - Runs the test suite.

Other tasks
-----------
app:compileJava - Compiles main Java source.
core:compileJava - Compiles main Java source.
app:compileTestJava - Compiles test Java source.
core:compileTestJava - Compiles test Java source.
components - Displays the components produced by root project 'gradle-multi'. [deprecated]
app:components - Displays the components produced by project ':app'. [deprecated]
core:components - Displays the components produced by project ':core'. [deprecated]
dependentComponents - Displays the dependent components of components in root project 'gradle-multi'. [deprecated]

core:dependentComponents - Displays the dependent components of components in project ':core'. [deprecated]

prepareKotlinBuildScriptModel
app:processResources - Processes main resources.
core:processResources - Processes main resources.
app:processTestResources - Processes test resources.
core:processTestResources - Processes test resources.
app:startScripts - Creates OS specific scripts to run the project as a JVM application.
